note: Every numeric constant of the process engine, with its unit and source. Python and TypeScript engines both read this file; scripts/check_units.py rejects undeclared literals in engine modules and entries without unit or source.

grid.top_um.source: Design: upper bound of the coarsest class, above the coarsest crusher feed in the catalog.

grid.n_classes.source: Design: the pan boundary falls at 3.24 um.

bond.reference_feed_um.source: Design: reference reduction at which Rittinger and Kick are calibrated to Bond.

bond.reference_product_um.source: Design: reference reduction at which Rittinger and Kick are calibrated to Bond.

mill.mixer_fractions.source: Austin, Klimpel and Luckie (1984): one large and two equal small perfect mixers; the fractions are this product's declared values.

water.density_t_m3.source: Process water at plant temperature, rounded.

plitt.d50_coefficient.source: Plitt (1976) CIM Bull. 69(776):114-123, as documented in SysCAD Hydrocyclone.

plitt.pressure_window_kpa.source: Flag window, authored: the Moly-Cop base case runs at 53 kPa; values outside the window are reported, not rejected.

flotation.sb_factor.source: Sb = 6 Jg/D32 (Gorain et al. 1997) with Jg in cm/s and D32 in mm.

savassi.constant.source: Savassi et al. (1998) Miner. Eng. 11(3):243-256, as typeset in Hoang et al. (2019) eq. 3.

batch.times_min.source: Design: laboratory batch-flotation sampling schedule for the virtual test.

numerics.recycle_rel_tolerance.source: Numerics: largest per-class relative change between recycle passes at convergence, so trace minerals close as tightly as the bulk (PE-02).

numerics.composite_scale_tolerance.source: Numerics: largest per-class change of the host-limited composite scale at convergence in the grinding circuit.

numerics.composite_scale_max_iterations.source: Numerics: iteration cap of the host-limited composite fixed point.

numerics.laguerre_nodes.source: Numerics: Gauss-Laguerre order for the residence-time projection.

grinding.energy_bracket_kwh_t.unit: kWh per t of mill feed per pass

flotation.composite_surface_exponent.source: Declared: the exposed surface of a composite grain scales with the two-thirds power of its valuable content.

numerics.negative_mass_tolerance_per_tph.source: Numerics: a class mass below minus this tolerance raises a negative-mass flag.

numerics.cut_search_step_ratio.source: Numerics: geometric step of the cut-size bracket search.

numerics.energy_guess_floor_kwh_t.source: Numerics: floor of the Bond-based starting guess for the energy search.

kinetics.beta_bounds.source: Declared: range of the exponent that keeps the model identifiable on a nine-point batch curve; above 1 the curve has a delayed onset (compressed), below 1 it reflects a spread of rates (stretched); dossier section 3.6, Vinnett and Waters (2025), doi:10.1016/j.mineng.2025.109246.

kinetics.dense_points.source: Design: samples of each fitted curve from 0 to the last batch time (0.25 min spacing over 16 min), for plotting from the record.

numerics.lm_damping_factor.source: Numerics: damping decrease on an accepted step and increase on a rejected one.

numerics.lm_damping_bounds.source: Numerics: damping limits; reaching the upper one means no step lowers the residual in double precision.

numerics.lm_diagonal_floor.source: Numerics: floor on the diagonal of the normal matrix used for Marquardt scaling.

optimization.starts.unit: unit cube of the decision bounds
optimization.starts.source: Design: five fixed starts that, with the nominal point, make the six COBYLA starts; the magnetite circuit uses the first coordinate of each.

optimization.rhobeg.unit: unit cube of the decision bounds
optimization.rhobeg.source: Numerics: initial COBYLA trust-region radius (Powell 1994), a quarter of each decision range.

optimization.rhoend.unit: unit cube of the decision bounds
optimization.rhoend.source: Numerics: final COBYLA trust-region radius (1e-4 of each decision range).

optimization.max_evaluations.source: Numerics: cap on circuit evaluations per COBYLA start.

optimization.feasibility_tolerance.source: Numerics: a point is feasible when every constraint holds within this relative tolerance.

optimization.active_tolerance.source: Design: a constraint whose relative slack at the optimum is below this is reported as active.

uncertainty.half_widths.unit: fraction of the variant value (uniform on 1 - h to 1 + h)
uncertainty.half_widths.source: Authored: ore-property spreads for the uncertainty and sensitivity records; not fitted to a deposit, stated as such on the Methodology page.

uncertainty.samples.source: Design: Monte Carlo sample size of the uncertainty record (PE-28).

uncertainty.seed.source: Design: seed of the scrambled Latin hypercube, so every record is reproducible.

uncertainty.quantiles.source: Design: P05, P50 and P95 of each output (PE-28).

sensitivity.base_samples.source: Design: Saltelli base sample N (a power of two); first- and total-order indices need N (D + 2) circuit evaluations.

sensitivity.resamples.source: Design: bootstrap resamples for the 95% confidence intervals of the Sobol indices (SALib).

sensitivity.confidence.source: Design: confidence level of the Sobol index intervals.

learning.design_points_per_case.source: Design: engine states per case in the learning design (a power of two for the Sobol sequence).

learning.seed.source: Design: seed of the learning design, the splits and every model.

learning.test_fraction.source: Design: share of each case's states held out by the interpolation protocol.

learning.validation_fraction.source: Design: share of the training rows held out for early stopping and for the guard threshold.

learning.ridge_alpha.source: Design: L2 penalty of the linear reference model on standardized features.

learning.forest_trees.source: Design: trees of the random forest (Breiman 2001).

learning.forest_min_leaf.source: Design: minimum samples per random-forest leaf.

learning.hgb_iterations.source: Design: boosting iterations of HistGradientBoostingRegressor (fixed, no internal early stopping).

learning.hgb_learning_rate.source: Design: shrinkage of the gradient-boosting surrogate.

learning.gp_training_rows.source: Design: seeded subsample the Gaussian process is fitted on (the exact GP costs O(n^3)).

learning.gp_restarts.source: Design: restarts of the GP marginal-likelihood optimizer.

learning.interval_z.source: Two-sided 95% quantile of the standard normal distribution, for GP interval coverage.

learning.mlp_hidden.source: Design: hidden layers of the multi-output MLP surrogate.

learning.mlp_learning_rate.source: Design: Adam step size (Kingma and Ba 2015).

learning.mlp_weight_decay.source: Design: decoupled weight decay of the MLP and the autoencoder.

learning.max_epochs.source: Design: epoch cap of the MLP and the autoencoder; training stops earlier on validation loss.

learning.patience.source: Design: epochs without a lower validation loss before training stops (the best weights are restored).

learning.autoencoder_hidden.source: Design: encoder, bottleneck and decoder widths of the out-of-envelope guard.

learning.guard_quantile.source: Design: the guard threshold is this quantile of the validation reconstruction error, so about 1% of in-envelope states raise a false alarm.

learning.ood_shift.source: Design: out-of-envelope probes move one feature this far beyond its training maximum.

learning.permutation_repeats.source: Design: repeats of permutation importance (Breiman 2001; scikit-learn permutation_importance).

learning.onnx_tolerance.source: Numerics: largest difference allowed between PyTorch and ONNX Runtime outputs of an exported model.

learning.gp_noise_initial.source: Design: starting noise level of the GP white-noise kernel; the marginal likelihood fits it.

learning.gp_noise_bounds.source: Design: white-noise bounds of the GP; the engine is deterministic, so the fitted noise is expected near the lower bound.

learning.gp_length_scale_bounds.source: Design: ARD length-scale bounds; a length scale at the upper bound means the feature is switched off.

learning.gp_bound_margin.source: Design: a fitted length scale above this share of its upper bound is reported as switched off.
